paragraphs: Rav Mari son of Rav Bizna.
He is mentioned in [Beitzah 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.28b.3), and it is implied there that he lived in the time of Rav Yosef.[^1][^2]

notes.text: כח: gives Beitzah 28b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification.

The linked Gemara presents separate rulings by Rav Mari and Rav Yosef on examining a slaughtering knife on the festival. Hyman infers their contemporaneity from their juxtaposition. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2383&lang=en) cites the same passage.
